# eOffice

> llms.txt for the eOffice repository (embeddedos-org/eOffice).
> Status: the office suite for EmbeddedOS — offline-first
> applications with CRDT-based sync and stated privacy
> invariants, implemented in Node.js.

eOffice is the productivity layer of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem.
Its design record is explicit about its guarantees: what
offline-first means per app, which privacy invariants hold,
and why sync uses CRDTs rather than OT.

## Docs

- [eOffice Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Offline-first guarantees](docs/offline-first-guarantees.md)
- [eOffice privacy invariants](docs/privacy-invariants.md)
- [Sync: CRDT vs OT — decision note](docs/sync-crdt-vs-ot.md)
- [eOffice v2.0.0 — Deployment Runbook](docs/DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md)
